    • Method Detail

      • setPrefIdent

        public void setPrefIdent()
        Scan the list of identifiers and select the most suitable to be used as the preferred identifier.

      • getEDIFIdent

        public java.lang.String getEDIFIdent()
        Get the net identifier translated for EDIF. All non alphanumeric characters other than "_" are changed to "_", and all "]" are removed. If the identifier does not start with a alpha then a "&" is prepended, apparently as per EDIF standard. Note that EDIF identifiers are case-insensitive, but we don't flatten the case here.
        Returns:
        the translated EDIF net identifier

      • getNet

        public Net getNet()
        Get a Net representing this NET. The Net returned is arbitrary and is the first in the list of connected Nets. Since all Nets in the list are connected any one will suffice in the netlist as the preferred ID is used when the final netlist is written out.
        Returns:
        a Net

      • isExtOutPort
